delta.comment:
COMPLETION EVIDENCE — READ BEFORE ACTING. The implementation this task records is ALREADY DONE and published in commit 1be64c6ea17cf20b992c85d6b44c1f6d5f099267. Ship MUST NOT redo the checkpoint repair.

WHY status is still `queued` and NOT `done`: backlogit's validate_status_transition pre-hook rejects both queued->done and queued->review. Reaching `done` would require Stage to first mark the task `active` (claiming execution) and then `done` (which may invoke the pre-task-completion gate broker / autoharness gate check). Both are Ship execution semantics and lie outside Stage's role boundary (P-010), so Stage deliberately did NOT force the transition. The `queued` status here means "awaiting Ship's normal shipment-closure transition", NOT "work not started". Status and evidence are reconciled by this comment plus the linked commit rather than by Stage simulating an execution lifecycle.

ACTION FOR SHIP: close this task through the normal 159-S closure path without performing any code or file change for it. The only artifact it covers (.backlogit/checkpoints/checkpoint-20260903-154713.json) is already in its final, contract-conforming state.

MANIFEST INVARIANT: 151.007-T must remain BOTH parented to 151-F AND a member of 159-S's manifest. Removing it from the manifest while leaving parent_id set would break FULL COVERAGE and silently flip 159-S from cascade-eligible to safe-close. Verified: classify_shipment_close_path returns CASCADE (qualifying_feature_ids=('151-F',)) both before and after this addition.

TRACEABILITY: stash 445C1DFB (archived, reason=harvested) -> deliberation 032-DL -> task 151.007-T -> commit 1be64c6e. Prior refs: PR 430, review thread PRRT_kwDORzpWpM6fHS7c, publication merge SHA 431527c8.

CHECKPOINT DISPOSITION — checkpoint-20260904-220151.json resolved under explicit one-checkpoint operator waiver.

OPERATOR AUTHORIZATION (verbatim): "Option 2 waiver authorized, engram fix stashed for follow-up to address future occurrences." Scope: waives the prune-on-restore gate for checkpoint-20260904-220151.json ONLY. It waives no other policy, authorizes no redo of work, and authorizes no change to Engram. The Engram defect is documented separately for follow-up.

WHY A WAIVER WAS NEEDED: the Stage crash-resumption protocol requires bounded prune-on-restore via Engram before resolving a restored checkpoint, and fails closed if Engram is unreachable. The prior Stage recovery session hit an Engram content_record schema failure at that step; in the present session no Engram tool surface is reachable at all (ENGRAM_UNAVAILABLE), so the gate is independently unsatisfiable here. The waiver is therefore applied transparently rather than the gate being silently skipped. No prune was attempted and none was performed.

RECORDING SURFACE (no invented schema field): backlogit exposes no amend/update operation for an existing checkpoint, and the governed disposition path backlogit_abandon_checkpoint (the only writer of the reserved disposition/disposition_reason/disposition_operator/disposition_at fields) is NOT present in this deployment — verified by tool discovery. The checkpoint record itself therefore cannot carry the waiver. This item-log comment event (registry operation append_comment, features.comments: true) is the supported record surface, attached to 151.007-T because that is the task the checkpoint tracks.
